capabilities: Replace system emoji with hand-drawn SVGs in reading view, Live Preview, source mode, and app UI
Toggle the replacement on or off via command palette or settings
Keep original emoji characters intact under the rendered artwork
extras: Independent project not made, sponsored, or endorsed by Frank Rausch; ships all artwork inside the plugin and makes no network requests. Manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Standard system emoji look generic and inconsistent with a hand-drawn or personal aesthetic, and there is no built-in way to change how emoji are displayed.

relations.evidence: The emoji artwork is FrankMoji © 2026 by Frank Rausch.

summary: Emoji renderer that replaces system emoji with hand-drawn FrankMoji-style SVGs across notes and the rest of the app.
